title: Apples Never Fall
author: Liane Moriarty
summary: The Delaney family are retired tennis coaches with four adult children. When the mother, Joy, disappears, the police look at her husband, and the family recalls a young woman who once stayed with them.
readIf: you like family dramas with wit and a mystery at the centre.
skipIf: you want a fast thriller or a story with a tidy detective plot.
